title: 0.2.24 OTA update detection fix
summary: This update fixes OTA version detection so the platform compares the packaged REVISION file instead of the GitHub branch head commit.
highlights: Update checks now read the remote REVISION file that will actually be installed.
Publishing metadata commits no longer make the platform report a false same-version update.
The update notice target revision now matches the packaged payload revision.
Regression tests cover the REVISION-file lookup and the existing rollback dependency-tree fix.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
